text: Then, accompanied by his attendants bearing tridents, auspicious drums and conches resounded. As he descended from the peaks of the celestial chariots, he praised the opportunity to serve the gods. Immediately, Vishvakarma presented him with a newly crafted sunshade, a thousand-rayed parasol. He, whose head was not far from the edge of his garment, appeared as if the Ganges were flowing down from the highest part of his body.
